title: Career & CV Counselling
description: The Career Service offers to USI students and recent graduates (alumni within 1 year of graduation) Career and CV Counselling and provides valuable advice on internship or job search, application documents drafting, and job interview preparation.

items.title: Request your Career & CV Counselling
items.html:
Book an individual counselling session by accessing USI CareerGate and selecting "Request Career & CV Counselling."

A team of specialised counsellors for entering the job market is available for online or in-person individual counselling sessions:

Counsellor Focus
Simona Bolis CV Strategy (counselling in Italian)
Louise Bostock CV Counselling and Motivation Letter in English
Carol Switzer Counselling for International Careers
Edoardo Beretta Counselling for Academic Careers
Patrick Zulian Counselling for Tech Careers
Rosalba Morese Counselling for Resilience for the Job Search
Elena Bittante Counselling for Careers in Space

Before booking a counselling session, please consult the “Guidelines for a Standout CV” section above.

items.title: CV Counselling by Industry Experts
items.html:
The CV Counselling by Industry Experts are one-to-one meetings, lasting 20-minutes, with professionals from different fields, to get a review and advise on Curriculum Vitae.

Appointments for the Autumn Semester 2026/2027:

  • 8 October 2026 - Focus Finance/Economics and Management Consulting
  • 29 October 2026 - Focus Informatics/tech
  • 24 November 2026 - Focus Luxury/Fashion and Focus Health/Pharma
  • 10 December 2026 - Focus Communication/Media, Culture and Tourism

Registration and full program

items.title: Career Management Workshops
items.html:
A series of workshops designed to help students strengthen their professional, interpersonal, soft, and transferable skills to support the successful launch of their careers.

Topics:

  • Create a Standout CV
  • Write a Winning Cover Letter
  • Ace your Interviews
  • Optimize your LinkedIn Profile
  • Strategize your Job Search
  • Get your foot into the door
  • Transform Rejection into Resilience

Registration and full program

items.title: Professional Mentoring
items.html:
USI Career Mentoring Programme

  • To support students in their transition into the world of work, the USI Career and Alumni Service offers Master’s students a Career Mentoring programme that connects students with experienced USI alumni.

More information and registration here.

BPW - USI Professional Mentoring for Women

  • BPW (Business Professional Women) in collaboration with the USI Equal Opportunities Service offer a Professional Mentoring Programme for female Master and PhD students.

More information here.
